title: Hearty Crisp Kenyan Lamb Kebabs
description: A peppery and crisp solo dinner dish featuring lamb, inspired by Kenyan cuisine, using lardons render for a rich flavor, and is kosher friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and salt.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
In a large skillet, render the lardons over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the skillet and set aside, leaving the rendered fat in the skillet.
Add the lamb skewers to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skewers to a baking sheet and brush with lemon juice and olive oil.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with crispy lardons and your choice of sides.
